messages:
anna_finance: Quick internal note: billing policy update rolling out Q2. Two changes: legacy free-credit top-ups will be phased out and we're introducing a short-term soft-throttle accounting window to reduce invoice volatility. Please read and flag questions.

billing-bot: TL;DR: free_credit_deprecate + soft_throttle_window (15m) for Hosted. Effective opt-in 2026-05-01; staged default later.

ray_support: Support ask: what will customers see on invoices and Console? Need exact phrasing for replies.

anna_finance: Invoices will show a new discrete line "Soft-throttle adjustment" when smoothing applies. Remaining legacy free credits will be converted to a one-time prorated credit unless customer opts into the new small-business credit plan. Console will have a preview tool.

kelly_prod: Runtime impact? Any header or meter changes we should expect?

anna_finance: Add two headers: X-Redwood-SoftThrottle and X-Redwood-AdjustedTokens. Meter events: soft_throttle_window_start, soft_throttle_applied. Eng teams should add dashboards under Billing -> Metering.

ivan_sre: I'll add smoke tests for header presence and an alert if adjustments are >20% for top accounts.

ray_support: I'll draft KB + canned replies and share for review by 2026-04-19. Escalations should use subject prefix [Billing-Rebalance].

sam_ceo: Thanks. One ask: make the first month after default migration opt-out to reduce churn risk.

anna_finance: Agreed. Rollout plan: 2026-05-01 opt-in tests; 2026-06-01 default for new Hosted; 2026-07-01 global default with 30-day opt-out for legacy Hosted. Dedicated unaffected unless explicitly migrated.

anna_finance: Action items: support to publish KB (ray_support by 2026-04-19), eng to emit headers/events and dashboards (kelly_prod/ivan_sre by 2026-04-24), sales to notify affected customers (sales ops by 2026-04-21), finance to update invoice template and Console preview (anna_finance by 2026-05-01).

billing-bot: Internal doc: https://redwood.example/internal/billing/credit-rebalance; KB draft: https://redwood.example/drafts/billing/credit-rebalance.

ray_support: Draft posted, pinged #sales and #customer-success for review.

billing-bot: End of thread.
